candidate: Lazily allocate one coordinator-owned aligned FRONTIER scratch buffer and reuse it only after each synchronous write/sync cycle completes. Re-encode the complete frame on every reuse. No per-group fields, deadline change, allocator switch, byte/hash/ACK or recovery change.
motivation: Retained source allocates/frees a 4096-byte posix_memalign buffer for every FRONTIER on the sync path. Existing excluded f7 profiles record11719 markers at1writer,1662 at8,1315 at16. Packer SHA dominates CPU, but moving it or coalescing membership previously failed; this isolates an avoidable allocation on the commit path without claiming it dominates SSD time.
scope: One source candidate only; stop after its bounded comparison for review. Source base retains all earlier accepted optimizations. No push/PR.
validation: Full outside-sandbox check, focused v7 wave/recapture/poison/short-marker/sync-failure tests. Extend real-cycle wave/recovery test to prove lazy allocation, stable pointer across cycles, dirty-buffer re-encoding, no-op reuse and exact recovery.
stages: Batch8 screen first, then batch16, batch1, point8, independent batch8 confirmation. Four warmups plus3 alternating four-arm rounds per cell. Cancel dependent cells after a v7 throughput/p99/DATA failure; no retries or replacement slow runs.
assessment: Every v7 stage requires paired and separate-arm median throughput>=0.95x, paired p99<=1.10x and equal DATA byte counts. Independent batch8 confirmation must improve throughput>1.00x and p99<1.00x. CPU/RSS/syncs/v4 controls diagnostic only; no CPU veto. Retain only if all stages complete and pass; else restore f7 source/executable and rebuild restored tests.
configuration: Fresh local ext4 SSD databases;1KiB values,2GiB SST,explicitParallel,no compaction. Batch64=750000 puts/sample10;point8=100000 puts/sample100.30s initial cooldown,10s gaps. Host audits before/during1Hz/after. No build/test/profile/source edits during scores.
publication: Retained source and evidence in separate local commits. If rejected, evidence-only commit. Preserve all raw observations, exact patch/build inputs/saved binary and restoration. Preserve prior evidence unchanged.
